scope: Acquisition and analysis of original fixed CRC browser observations only; no measurement, runtime or frozen-auditor changes.
artifactSelection: Exactly one non-expired artifact with name crc-no-unroll-browser-beb5-{dictionary}-AB from the fixed run/head/attempt; ID/size/SHA are resolved prospectively named from the authenticated API, recorded and verified before extraction.
outputPolicy: Keep every outer ZIP and original member unchanged. Local frozen auditor uses local-independent-audit.json and separate stdout/stderr. Every failure is retained; no replacement, trimming, pooling or control subtraction.
